_README: JOB OPENINGS — edit this file, then run: node build.js
Each entry renders three things automatically: the card on /careers/, the
role option in the apply dropdown, and (only when status is 'open') the
JobPosting JSON-LD that Google for Jobs reads.
status: 'draft' → shown on the page with a DRAFT badge, but EXCLUDED from
JSON-LD so a placeholder can never be indexed as a real
job. Use this while you're still writing the role.
status: 'open'  → live. Included in JSON-LD. Only use this for genuine
openings you are actually hiring for.
status: 'closed'→ hidden from the page entirely.
FIELD NOTES
workplace       → the human-readable work mode shown on the card
(e.g. 'Hybrid — Pune / Mumbai'). Display only.
city / region   → structured location used for JSON-LD only. Omit both
for fully-remote roles with no anchor office.
remote: true    → adds TELECOMMUTE + India applicant requirement to JSON-LD.
employmentType  → schema.org vocabulary ONLY: CONTRACTOR, FULL_TIME,
PART_TIME, TEMPORARY, INTERN, OTHER. Not free text.
datePosted / validThrough are ISO dates (YYYY-MM-DD). Google requires
validThrough to be in the future or the posting is dropped.
